title: Web Vite TanStack Runtime
problem: Nako Web still carries a temporary Next.js bootstrap shell even though route ownership, API seams, and Tauri packaging are now static TanStack responsibilities.
gates: Browser/Playwright smoke for visible frontend route changes
evidence: WVRT-010 opened this durable runtime migration lane from the completed WVTR copy-first refactor.
WVRT-020 added the Vite React entry, moved root runtime concerns into Vite-owned files, preserved /tv through TanStack Router, and passed npm --prefix web run check plus npm --prefix web run build.
WVRT-030 removed Next app wrappers, Next config/type files, and Next dependencies while keeping Vite check/build green and preserving the route inventory.
WVRT-040 pointed Tauri at Vite dist, passed static route smoke with no console messages, passed Tauri tests, and built the Windows shell binary without a Node sidecar.
WVRT-050 closed the runtime migration lane and split remaining route/data-source tests, bundle optimization, source-tree reshaping, and product feature wiring as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: This WVRT lane is closed. Continue in narrower follow-ons for route/data-source tests, initial bundle optimization, source-tree reshaping, expanded Admin/Addons/media feature wiring, native playback, or mobile packaging.
